Rule.Name: RxdkXboxImage
Rule.Description: imagebld settings used to build the Xbox .xbe.

StringProperty.Name: RxdkStackSize
StringProperty.Description: Title thread stack size in bytes (imagebld /stack). Decimal, e.g. 131072 for 0x20000.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkImageDebug
BoolProperty.Description: Include the debug directory in the XBE so the debugger can resolve symbols (imagebld /debug).

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkNoLogo
BoolProperty.Description: Do not print the imagebld banner (imagebld /nologo).

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkLimitMemory
BoolProperty.Description: Run the title as if the console has only 64 MB of RAM (imagebld /limitmem).

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkDontModifyHardDisk
BoolProperty.Description: Prevent the title from modifying the retail hard disk layout (imagebld /dontmodifyhd).

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkDontMountUtilityDrive
BoolProperty.Description: Do not mount the utility (Z:) drive at launch (imagebld /dontmountud). Cannot be combined with Format Utility Drive.

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkFormatUtilityDrive
BoolProperty.Description: Format the utility (Z:) drive at launch (imagebld /formatud). Cannot be combined with Don't Mount Utility Drive.

EnumProperty.Name: RxdkUtilityDriveClusterSize
EnumProperty.Description: Cluster size for the utility drive (imagebld /udcluster). Default lets imagebld choose.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkNoPreload
StringListProperty.Description: Section names that should NOT be preloaded at launch (imagebld /nopreload). One entry per section.
